mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password_hash, role, status, must_change_password, created_at, updated_at FROM nc_account ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nc_account (username, password_hash, role, status, must_change_password, created_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{role}, #{status}, #{mustChangePassword}, NOW(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE nc_account SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, role = #{role}, status = #{status}, must_change_password = #{mustChangePassword}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}
